source_row.rationale: Carbamazepine carries a risk of blood dyscrasias, including potentially serious effects on white blood cells, red blood cells, or platelets, requiring regular CBC monitoring throughout therapy to detect these changes early.
source_row.source_detail: Blood Dyscrasia Risk and CBC Monitoring
